sentences.text: Sansa Stark is a fictional character created by American author George R. R. Martin .	George R. R. Martin	George R. R. Martin	fictional character	fictional character
She is a prominent character in Martin 's award-winning A Song of Ice and Fire series .	A Song of Ice and Fire	A Song of Ice and Fire

Introduced in 1996 's A Game of Thrones , Sansa is the eldest daughter and second child of Lord Eddard Stark and his wife Lady Catelyn Stark .	Game of Thrones	Game of Thrones	A Game of Thrones	A Game of Thrones	Eddard Stark	Ned Stark	Catelyn Stark	Catelyn Stark

She subsequently appeared in the following three novels , A Clash of Kings -LRB- 1998 -RRB- , A Storm of Swords -LRB- 2000 -RRB- and A Feast for Crows -LRB- 2005 -RRB- .	A Clash of Kings	A Clash of Kings	A Storm of Swords	A Storm of Swords	A Feast for Crows	A Feast for Crows

While absent from the fifth novel A Dance with Dragons as the books are separated geographically , Sansa is confirmed to return in the forthcoming next book in the series , The Winds of Winter .	A Dance with Dragons	A Dance with Dragons	The Winds of Winter	The Winds of Winter
In HBO 's adaptation of the series , Game of Thrones , Sansa Stark is played by Sophie Turner .	Game of Thrones	Game of Thrones	Sophie Turner	Sophie Turner	HBO	HBO
The character has received critical acclaim , being praised as the 4th greatest character in the series by Rolling Stone .	Rolling Stone	Rolling Stone

She and the rest of the cast were nominated for Screen Actors Guild Awards for Outstanding Performance by an Ensemble in a Drama Series in 2012 , 2014 , 2015 and 2016 .	Outstanding Performance by an Ensemble in a Drama Series	Screen Actors Guild Award for Outstanding Performance by an Ensemble in a Drama Series
